title: Checkout
demoNotice: Demo store: payments are simulated and no money is taken.

destination.title: Where to?
destination.intro: Country, city and postal code are enough to show the delivery options and prices. A street address is needed only for delivery, not for pickup from the studio.
destination.postalHint: Optional in Israel. Required abroad, unless the destination has no postal codes.

errors.postalRequired: Enter a postal code. It is needed for delivery to this destination.

delivery.stepTitle: {count, plural, one {How would you like to receive it?} other {How would you like to receive them?}}
delivery.worksPrice: {count, plural, one {Price of the work} other {Price of the # works}}
delivery.unavailable: The delivery option you chose is not available for this destination. Please choose another one.
delivery.packingStretchedNote: The painting is sent as it is, stretched on its wooden frame.
delivery.packingRolledNote: The canvas is taken off its stretcher and sent rolled in a tube: shipping costs far less, and large paintings can go by Israel Post. On arrival it needs re-stretching on a frame (a framer can do it), at the buyer's cost.

notices.DAP_DUTIES: Import duties, taxes and clearance fees at the destination, if any, are paid by you on delivery (DAP).
notices.EU_LOW_VALUE_DUTY: From 1 July 2026 to 1 July 2028 the EU charges a flat EUR 3 customs duty on low-value parcels.
notices.US_DUTY_FREE_CLEARANCE_FEES: Original paintings (HS 9701.91) enter the US duty free; the carrier may still charge clearance fees.
notices.US_FORMAL_ENTRY: Above USD 2,500 you are the importer of record (formal entry, CBP Form 5106).
notices.TRANSIT_ESTIMATE: Transit times are estimates and may change at customs.

details.title: Your details
details.name: Full name
details.emailHint: Your order confirmation and documents are sent here.
details.phoneHint: For the courier. International format is fine (+44…).
details.latinHint: For international shipping please write the address in Latin (English) letters.
details.receiptHint: Only if the receipt should be in a company's or business's name.
details.vatId: VAT / company ID for the receipt
details.pickupNote: The studio address and pickup instructions are sent after payment.

consent.terms: I have read and accept the terms of sale and the cancellation and returns policy.
consent.dap: I understand that import duties, taxes and fees at the destination are mine to pay (DAP).
consent.required: Please tick this box to continue.

provider.pendingNote: Card payment will be switched on once Isracard approves our merchant account. Until then you can't pay on the site, and no order is created.
provider.pendingContact: To buy a work now, contact us.
provider.paypal: PayPal (account, or card where PayPal offers it)
provider.redirectNote: On the next page you pay securely: card details go only to the payment provider.

secure.title: Secure payment
secure.body: Card details are entered only in the payment provider's secure fields or page (PCI DSS) and never reach this site's servers. Where required, the payment is verified with 3-D Secure by your card issuer.

cardPage.title: The secure payment page asks for:
cardPage.secureFields: Card number, expiry and CVV, in Isracard's secure fields
cardPage.holder: The card holder's name and, for an Israeli card, ID number
cardPage.contact: The card holder's email and phone
cardPage.pendingButton: The button opens the payment page once Isracard activates card payment.

privacy: We use your details only to fulfil this order: payment, delivery and the receipt. You are not legally required to provide them, but we cannot complete the purchase without them. They are shared with the payment provider and the carrier only.
holdNotice: When you continue, {count, plural, one {the work is} other {the # works are}} reserved for you for {minutes} minutes.
